'''Dud Bolt's Podracer''' was a [[Vulptereen 327/Legends|Vulptereen 327]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] owned and operated by [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]]. The vehicle had great traction, but poor [[Engine/Legends|engine]] ventilation and acceleration with a top speed of 760 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="Podracer" />
